sql.if: AND ( (scope.selfOnly AND s.user_id = scope.userId) OR (scope.departmentId != null AND s.department_id = scope.departmentId) OR (scope.hasClassIds AND s.clazz_id IN #{id}) OR (scope.teacherId != null AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM course co_scope WHERE co_scope.id = sc.course_id AND co_scope.teacher_id = scope.teacherId)) OR (scope.hasCourseIds AND sc.course_id IN #{id}) )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM score sc JOIN student s ON sc.student_id = s.id JOIN course c ON sc.course_id = c.id WHERE sc.deleted = 0

SELECT CASE WHEN sc.score < 60 THEN 0 WHEN sc.score < 70 THEN 1 WHEN sc.score < 80 THEN 2 WHEN sc.score < 90 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM score sc JOIN student s ON sc.student_id = s.id JOIN course c ON sc.course_id = c.id WHERE sc.deleted = 0
GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

SELECT c.clazz_name AS clazzName, ROUND(AVG(sc.score), 2) AS avgScore FROM score sc JOIN student s ON sc.student_id = s.id JOIN clazz c ON s.clazz_id = c.id WHERE sc.deleted = 0
GROUP BY c.id, c.clazz_name ORDER BY avgScore DESC

SELECT c.course_name AS courseName, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN sc.score >= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS passRate FROM score sc JOIN course c ON sc.course_id = c.id WHERE sc.deleted = 0
GROUP BY c.id, c.course_name ORDER BY passRate DESC

SELECT c.course_name AS courseName, ROUND(AVG(sc.score), 2) AS avgScore FROM score sc JOIN course c ON sc.course_id = c.id WHERE sc.deleted = 0
GROUP BY c.id, c.course_name ORDER BY avgScore DESC

SELECT s.name AS studentName, ROUND(AVG(sc.score), 2) AS avgScore FROM score sc JOIN student s ON sc.student_id = s.id WHERE sc.deleted = 0
GROUP BY s.id, s.name ORDER BY avgScore DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(sc.exam_time, '%Y-%m') AS examMonth, ROUND(AVG(sc.score), 2) AS avgScore FROM score sc JOIN student s ON sc.student_id = s.id JOIN course c ON sc.course_id = c.id WHERE sc.deleted = 0
AND sc.exam_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY examMonth ORDER BY examMonth

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN sc.score >= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passCount, SUM(CASE WHEN sc.score < 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failCount FROM score sc JOIN student s ON sc.student_id = s.id JOIN course c ON sc.course_id = c.id WHERE sc.deleted = 0

SELECT c.course_name AS courseName, sc.score AS score, s.name AS studentName FROM score sc JOIN student s ON sc.student_id = s.id JOIN course c ON sc.course_id = c.id WHERE sc.deleted = 0 AND sc.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY c.course_name
